edits.new: "A and B are groups of masks from social media posts. Each mask is a list of text fragments selected from one post; interpret its fragments together. Do the two groups express the same topic at the same level of generality? For each group, consider the most specific topic that covers the subject matter of all its masks. Answer yes only if those topics are equivalent; different wording and examples need not make them different. Answer no if the topics differ, including when one is broader or narrower than the other. Answer uncertain if the masks do not establish whether the topics are equivalent."
edits.old: "A and B name topics used to organize social media posts. Does B fall entirely within A's subject matter? Answer yes if discussing B is necessarily discussing A, including when both titles name the same topic. Mere association or partial overlap is not enough: if B can be discussed without discussing A itself, answer no. If you cannot determine this from the meanings of the titles, answer uncertain."

edits.new: "yes": "The groups express the same topic at the same level of generality"
"no": "The groups express different topics or different levels of generality"

edits.old: "uncertain": "Cannot determine this from the meanings of the titles"
